$comment: Step 3 of the Flow. Exists because Alation Flows have no transform node — NodeType is exactly {type_start, type_agent, type_tool} — so rendering JSON as markdown has to be done by a model. Tool-less and catalog-blind on purpose: it renders findings it was handed and must not be able to look anything up, because a lookup would let it add facts the gap analysis never established.
name: gap_report_writer
description: Renders a catalog gap analysis (JSON from bcbs239_pde_mapper) as a markdown report for a data governance lead: coverage table worst-status-first, what to bind each critical data element to, the data quality monitors proposed with their thresholds and paragraph authority, and what is blocked and why. Presentation only — adds no findings, recomputes no counts, and never invents a table, column or citation.

message.description: The gap-analysis JSON from bcbs239_pde_mapper. In a Flow this arrives as a reference to the previous node's output; the message slot has no size cap. ~40KB is normal.
